value.summary: The change adds pricing entries and tests without modifying any security-sensitive control flow. The new models, the DEFAULTS lookup, and the completion_cost/unpriced calls are all test-only or compile-time constant data. No untrusted input reaches a dangerous sink, no authentication or authorisation path is altered, no network or subprocess calls are introduced, no deserialization of untrusted data occurs, the path is written in tests only (no traversal risk), no secrets move into code or logs, no dependencies change, and CI permissions are not touched. Mechanical policy rules about formatting, module structure, and docs are not checked here. Safe to merge.
